<!-- Google tag (gtag.js) -->
    <script>
      const hostname = window.location.hostname;
      const isLocalEnvironment =
        window.location.protocol === 'file:' ||
        hostname === '' ||
        ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0'].includes(hostname) ||
        hostname.endsWith('.local');

      if (!isLocalEnvironment) {
        const GA_MEASUREMENT_ID = 'G-F6VBE87BG0';
        const GA_PLATFORM = 'demo-webapp';
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        const pageLocation = url.href;
        const pagePath = `${url.pathname}${url.search}`;
        const referrer = document.referrer || '(direct)';
        const utm = Object.fromEntries(
          ['source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'content', 'term'].map((key) => [
            `utm_${key}`,
            url.searchParams.get(`utm_${key}`) || '(not_set)',
          ]),
        );

        const gaScript = document.createElement('script');
        gaScript.async = true;
        gaScript.src = `https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID}`;
        document.head.appendChild(gaScript);

        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

        function gtag() {
          window.dataLayer.push(arguments);
        }

        window.gtag = gtag;

        gtag('js', new Date());
        gtag('set', { platform: GA_PLATFORM });
        gtag('set', 'user_properties', {
          platform: GA_PLATFORM,
          entry_url: pageLocation,
          entry_referrer: referrer,
          ...utm,
        });
        gtag('config', GA_MEASUREMENT_ID, {
          page_path: pagePath,
          page_location: pageLocation,
          page_title: document.title,
        });

        const sessionKey = 'oi-demo-ga-session';
        const isNewSession = !sessionStorage.getItem(sessionKey);
        const eventPayload = {
          page_path: pagePath,
          page_location: pageLocation,
          page_title: document.title,
          entry_referrer: referrer,
          ...utm,
        };

        if (isNewSession) {
          sessionStorage.setItem(sessionKey, 'initialized');
          gtag('event', 'demo_session_start', eventPayload);
        }

        gtag('event', 'demo_page_view', eventPayload);
      }
    </script>
